summary: Full end-to-end review of the new Manufacturer Logistics Command Center (/manufacturer/logistics-center). Created /app/backend/tests/test_logistics.py — 15/15 pass (overview shape, transfers CRUD + insufficient-stock 400 + same-src/dst 400, advance deliver/cancel, replenishment approve/reject + already-decided 400, Vertex AI recompute + execute + double-execute 400, multi-tenant isolation Unilever vs Flour Mills). Frontend: page renders with data-testid='logistics-command-center', all 7 KPI cards present and populated (Total Inventory 183.9K, Warehouses 7, Open Orders 86, etc.), Google Map renders with 7 warehouse markers + 12 lanes + 8 trucks, alerts panel populated with working Critical/Warning/Info filter chips, AI recommendation card (data-testid='ai-recommendation-card') invokes Vertex AI on recompute (~5-30s) and shows from→to warehouses, allocation queue has 6 Approve/Partial/Reject buttons, 3 Authorization tabs (warehouse/distributor/wholesaler) switch correctly, Create Transfer dialog opens with data-testid='transfer-submit-btn', 8 transfer-deliver-* buttons present, Quick Actions panel renders, KPI Warehouses drill-down navigates to /manufacturer/warehouses (correctly shows 7 warehouses). Regression check: /manufacturer/warehouses still works (7 warehouses listed with codes/locations/values).

ui_bugs.issue: When backend clamps quantity to 0 (source warehouse drained — common after several executions in dev), the card displays 'Move 0 units of <product>' while the AI narrative still says e.g. 'Transfer 855 units…'. The ai-execute-btn remains clickable but the backend returns 400 'Recommendation has no transferable quantity'. UX: when clamped_quantity == 0, hide/disable Execute and surface a helper like 'Insufficient stock — recompute'.

data-testid attribute contains a space ('nav-logistics center') — atypical and brittle for selector targeting. Recommend renaming to 'nav-logistics-center' (kebab-case) for consistency with other testids in the codebase.

test_scenarios_executed.name: GET /api/logistics/overview shape (kpis x7 + map + alerts sorted critical-first + allocation_queue + authorization x3 + pipeline monotonic + forecast + transfers)
POST /api/logistics/transfers — same src/dst 400, qty > available 400, valid create returns TRF-xxx in_transit with vehicle assigned, source inventory decremented
PATCH /api/logistics/transfers/{id}/advance deliver -> status delivered + destination credited + truck freed; cancel -> source restored; second deliver -> 400
POST /api/logistics/requests/{id}/decide approve warehouse req creates transfer; reject sets status; double-decide 400
POST /api/logistics/ai-recommendation/recompute returned ai_status='vertex_ai', valid from!=to + product name; execute created TRF-xxx; double-execute returned 400
Multi-tenant isolation — flour.admin sees zero overlap of warehouses/trucks with Unilever

Frontend login as unilever@tradekonekt.io, sidebar 'Logistics Center' link navigates to /manufacturer/logistics-center, all 8 testids confirmed (logistics-command-center, logistics-map, 7 kpi-*, alerts-filter-critical/warning, ai-recommendation-card, ai-recompute-btn, auth-tab-{warehouse,distributor,wholesaler}, transfers-create-btn, transfer-submit-btn)
Frontend AI recompute -> Vertex AI -> ai-execute-btn rendered -> click execute completed
Frontend KPI drill-down: kpi-warehouses -> /manufacturer/warehouses (7 warehouses listed correctly)
Regression — /manufacturer/warehouses still renders 7 warehouses with codes/locations/values

action_items: Hide/disable the Execute Transfer button when the AI recommendation's clamped quantity is 0 (or auto-trigger a recompute) — currently the narrative says e.g. 855 units while card displays 'Move 0 units' and execute 400s.
Rename sidebar testid from 'nav-logistics center' (with space) to 'nav-logistics-center' for consistency.
Optional: surface ai_status badge color (Vertex AI vs fallback_rules) so ops can tell when graceful degradation kicked in.
critical_code_review_comments: logistics.py is 970 lines — consider splitting into routes/logistics_overview.py + routes/logistics_transfers.py + routes/logistics_ai.py to honour the <700 line guideline.

_create_transfer mutates inventory (decrement) and inserts shipment + transfer_orders + vehicle update across 4 collections without a transaction. If any later step fails, source stock is silently decremented with no transfer record. Consider wrapping in an async MongoDB transaction or compensating cleanup.

AI quantity clamp at line 914: rec['quantity'] = 0 when source empty results in a stored recommendation that cannot be executed — see frontend bug above. Better to reject the recommendation and fall back to rule-based selection of a different product.

seed_data_creation: None — tests use existing demo seed. TEST_-prefixed transfer reasons used so they can be filtered out of dashboards if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are stable at 15/15. The AI execute flow can show 'Move 0 units' on subsequent recomputes when source stock has been drained — this is correct backend clamp behaviour but a frontend UX miss. Vertex AI typically completes in 4-8s but can take up to 60s under 429 quota retries. Some Unilever warehouses (South East/West/South/North East) legitimately have 0 stock, so health='critical' on those is correct.
